problem_text: Two blocks are moving in opposite direction towards each other in a linear track with no friction. Block A is on the left and is moving to the right. The mass of block A (m$_a$) is 100 nanograms and length=width=height=200nm, and velocity (va1) before collision is 0 m/s. Block B is on the right and is moving to the left. The mass of block (m$_b$) is 200 nanograms and length=width=height=400nm, and velocity (vb1) before collision is 100m/s and is moving to the right. After the collision, block B moves to the right with a velocity (vb2) of 10 km/s. Calculate the final velocity of block A (va2).
